product.description: Synthetic daily temperature example, not the existing HRRR product.

identity.row_description: One synthetic value per h3_index, interval_start, interval_end.

spatial.domain: Synthetic fixture universe: exactly 8628d1067ffffff and 8628d105fffffff; no regional coverage claim.
spatial.method: Illustrative values assigned to whole cells; no source interpolation or scientific calculation.

temporal.aggregation: Illustrative hourly samples, equal weighting; a complete interval has one sample per elapsed hour. Partial estimates require at least half of the expected samples; otherwise null.
temporal.label_definition: Calendar date containing interval_start in America/Los_Angeles; boundaries are successive local midnights.

h3_index.description: Canonical H3 cell index at resolution 6.

date.description: Calendar date in the declared zone.

temperature_c.description: Synthetic air temperature; illustrative height 2 m above surface.
temperature_c.statistic: arithmetic mean of available hourly samples

temperature_status.description: Coverage and missingness state of the associated value.

configuration.description: Exact UTF-8 bytes of synthetic-config.json beside this manifest; complete fixture configuration.

sources.spatial_coverage: Two synthetic H3 R6 cells; no observations.
sources.temporal_coverage: Invented values for the intervals described in this manifest, or static examples.
sources.redistribution: Synthetic fixture only; no external source data included.

provenance.processing: Hand-authored synthetic fixture; not emitted by the named toolkit.

limitations: Illustrative proposal only; producer version and all-zero Git SHA are placeholders, not a real build.
Values are invented and must not be used for analysis.
This hourly aggregation is illustrative; actual toolkit weather uses its own sampling and coverage contract.
